docs/sprints/S09-a-day-at-nanis.md (the door: Zafar's 19-20 Oct lines, newest last)

tasks.do: DOOR-01: the door's sky is the s09b sky for the day's weather (assets/day/s09b/sky-sunny, -cloudy, -raining, -night) as a full layer behind house-empty.webp, scaled so the house's roofline (y 322 of 1024 in the cut) sits about a third of the way down on every screen and the house covers the width (crop its sides on squarer screens); code draws only what moves (falling rain, twinkling stars, drifting clouds); remove the old flat house and code-drawn sun.
tasks.accept: DOOR-01's probes at 1366x768, 844x390, 1024x768 (build the cloudy, raining and night paths in flows/day.mjs)

tasks.do: DOOR-02: Nani is drawn from the s09b pose cut-outs (nani-wave, nani-welcome, nani-point-up, nani-umbrella, nani-listen, nani-fan, nani-shade-eyes) at about half the screen height, feet at the foot of the steps (in front of the porch, so she may be taller than the door), all poses at one height; her pose follows her lines: wave on 'Come!', point up or shade her eyes on the weather (the umbrella when raining, the fan when sunny), welcome on the day's line, listen while she waits for Ha!. Pose changes are a short cross-fade.

DOOR-03 and DOOR-04: the sidebar's two cards (the weather picture, then the activity) appear as their sentences are spoken, each with the shared speaker icon and the Kutchi beneath (idea 55, like the pantry's items); the shared Ha! and Na pills, Na shakes; her lines in the shared bubble in the sky's upper left; nothing clipped and Nani never under the sidebar at all 8 sizes.
tasks.accept: DOOR-03's crops; DOOR-04's noClip and noOverlap at the 8 sizes

tasks.do: DAY-01: the day runner (Zafar, 20 Oct: 'built modularly, so it's easy to chop and change the sequence'). data/days.json lists each day as an ordered list of stages, each {stage, ...its settings} (door with its weather and line set; activity: kitchen or clinic; ride with its road and vehicle; book; and the not-yet-built pack, meet, game, stall, home with their settings). js/day/day.js plays the list in order through one stage interface (start(day, log) -> done), writes each stage's results to the day log, and skips an unbuilt stage with a lab note. Move the five existing days into it (day 2 the farm: door, pack (skipped), ride, meet (skipped), feed (skipped), eggs (skipped), snap (skipped), corn stall (skipped), animals home (skipped), home (skipped), book). build/test_day_runner.mjs proves swap, add, remove, reorder and copy need no code, and that an unbuilt stage is skipped.

DAY-02: two whole-day flows in flows/day.mjs: day:full-farm (door, ride, book with the ride's finds) and day:full-kitchen (door, hand-off to Cook, then the evening book when day.html is opened again, as today; if a real way back needs a Cook change, request it). Reuse the ride's and the book's own drivers by importing them, never by copying.
tasks.accept: DAY-02's probes: both flows reach their end
